_comment: What the Windows installer's build downloads, pinned (D742): the file is refused if its SHA-256 differs. To update: change the version and url, download the file once, and put `sha256sum` of it here (and say so in the log).

webview2._comment: Microsoft's small bootstrapper of the WebView2 Runtime. Microsoft replaces it in place, so it cannot be pinned by hash; the build checks that it is signed by Microsoft instead.
